dedupe_keys.name: national public transport data repository nptdr great britain 2004 to 2011

description: The National Public Transport Data Repository holds a snapshot of every public transport journey in Great Britain for a selected week in October each year from 2004 to 2011. It was compiled from local public transport information from each Traveline region, coach services from the national coach services database and rail information from the Association of Train Operating Companies. It was mainly used by local authorities and others to produce accessibility indicators with tools such as Accession. Coverage is national for Great Britain. Each year is a zip file, now served from the UK Government Web Archive, free under the Open Government Licence. Caveats: the data set is static and has been superseded by the Traveline National Dataset, and each year covers one week only. The archive supports historical accessibility, network flow and resilience studies of public transport, for instance to compare service levels before and after changes. It complements the Bus Open Data Service, NaPTAN and the multilayer temporal network of 2010 catalogued here.
